Please confirm the delivery date with Midlands Packaging Supplies before submitting this order, as the warehouse has noted that the supplier has been quoting extended lead times since the summer. The Distribution Centre has flagged that the new film should be stored in the dry bay, not the general consumables area, to avoid condensation damage.

PO-2026-0484 (City Press Services) – Printing plates, 0.30 mm thickness.
Raised 2 September 2026. Status: Submitted.
Quantity: 200 plates at £3.85 each. This order replaces the balance of PO-2026-0462 which was partially received in July. The remaining 40 plates from that order were never delivered and the supplier has confirmed that they will not be fulfilled; a credit note is expected. The plates are required for the WEEKEND EDITION of 19 September 2026 and the following week's run. The plate consumption has been higher than usual this month due to the number of colour pages being produced. The production manager has asked that we keep a reserve of 50 plates on site at all times, so please advise if the quantity on this order needs to be increased. The supplier has quoted a delivery date of 10 September 2026, which is acceptable.

PO-2026-0485 (Northern Ink & Coatings Ltd) – Black ink, 20 L pails.
Raised 3 September 2026. Status: Approved.
Quantity: 40 pails at £38.20 per pail. This order was approved on 4 September 2026 following confirmation that the black ink stock had fallen below the level required for the weekend production run. Delivery is scheduled for 8 September 2026. Please note that the ink must be signed for by a member of the production team, not left in the loading bay, as there have been issues with unidentified deliveries being moved to the wrong storage area. The previous black ink order (PO-2026-0477) was received in full on 1 September and has been placed in the main ink store. The stock check on 2 September showed 14 pails in hand, which is sufficient for the 5 September weekend edition but not for the following week.

PO-2026-0486 (Precision Press Parts) – Ink rollers, rubber, set of four.
Raised 4 September 2026. Status: Draft.
This order has been raised following a recommendation from the fitter who will be carrying out the maintenance work on the press line later this month. The fitter has advised that the current ink rollers are showing signs of wear and should be replaced during the same maintenance window as the packing sheets on PO-2026-0473. The quantity and unit price have not yet been confirmed; the fitter is due to provide a specification and a quote by 11 September 2026. Please hold this order until the specification has been received. The rollers are not required for the current production schedule, but the maintenance window will only be available until the end of September, so there is some urgency in confirming the details. The fitter has asked that the rollers be delivered directly to the press hall, not to the general stores.
